verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੮ : ਬੋਹੜ ਦੇ ਫੈਲਾਉ ਵਾਂਗ ਗੁਰਸਿੱਖ ਨਾਮ ਪ੍ਰਚਾਰਦੇ ਹਨ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 18 : bohaR dhe failaau vaa(n)g gursi'kh naam prachaaradhe han

en.bdb: Like the expansion of banyan tree of the Sikhs of the Guru spread Nam

verses.gurmukhi: ਧਰਤਿ ਵੜੈ ਵੜਿ ਬੀਉ ਹੋਇ ਜੜ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ।
verses.translit_en: dharat vaRai vaR beeau hoi jaR a(n)dhar ja(n)mai|

en.bdb: The seed enters the earth and settles in the form of root.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਬਰੂਟਾ ਚੁਹਚੁਹਾ ਮੂਲ ਡਾਲ ਧਰੰਮੈ।
verses.translit_en: hoi barooTaa chuhachuhaa mool ddaal dhara(n)mai|

en.bdb: Then in the form of verdant plant it becomes stem and branches.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਖ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਬਿਥਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਬਹੁ ਜਟਾ ਪਲੰਮੈ।
verses.translit_en: birakh akaar bithaar kar bahu jaTaa pala(n)mai|

en.bdb: Becoming tree it extends further and tangled branches hang from it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਟਾ ਲਟਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਧਰਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੋਇ ਮੂਲ ਅਗੰਮੈ।
verses.translit_en: jaTaa laTaa mil dharat vich hoi mool aga(n)mai|

en.bdb: These flourishing branches ultimately entering the earth again attain the form of roots.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਾਂਵ ਘਣੀ ਪਤ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਫਲ ਲੱਖ ਲਖੰਮੈ।
verses.translit_en: chhaa(n)v ghanee pat sohane fal la'kh lakha(n)mai|

en.bdb: Now its shade becomes think and leaves appear beautiful and millions of fruits grow on it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਫਲ ਫਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬੀਅ ਬਹੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਰੰਮੈ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit_en: fal fal a(n)dhar beea bahu gursikh mara(n)mai ||18||

en.bdb: In each fruit remain many seeds (and this process goes on). The mystery of the Sikhs of the Guru is the same; they also like banyan tree go on spreading the name of the Lord.
